idea-plugin.description:
TestFly Studio for JetBrains IDEs — AI test automation integration with TestFly & Playwright MCP.

Pairs with Playwright MCP for live browser inspection and provides TestFly Java 21 code generation, action-cache inspection, and self-healing patch remediation.

  • Interactive Tool Window sidebar panel (Dashboard, Action Cache, AI Self-Healing Patches)
  • TestFly native Page Object (BasePage), TestNG (BaseTest), and JUnit 5 (BaseJUnit5Test) codegen
  • Accessibility-first locators (getByRole, getByLabel, getByTestId, find) and web-first auto-waiting assertThat assertions
  • Action Cache (.testfly/action-cache.json) management for autonomous act() goals
  • Self-Healing Git diff (.patch) remediation management
  • No ChromeDriver or Python setup required

TestFly Documentation
